title: Rainbow Ring
description: The first time you play an Attack, Skill, and Power each turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Tracks each card type (Attack, Skill, Power) played this turn separately. Once all three types have been played, applies the Strength and Dexterity bonuses once and blocks further activations until the next turn begins.
